info.name: In search of the Mind of Maple

descriptions.notStarted: There's a legendary necklace called the #rMind of Maple#k that everyone would like to have their hands on....... Once the Gate of Time opens, #bMr. Moneybags#k will bring the blessing to everyone. Do you have the #rMind of Maple#k? Only #bMr. Moneybags#k knows the secret behind the necklace. Go visit #bMr. Moneybags immediately.
descriptions.inProgress:
Gather up the items Mr. Moneybags asked you to get through #bChief Stan#k in order to restore the #rMind of Maple#k to its original state.

descriptions.completed: The #rMind of Maple#k has been restored to its original state. If you want one yourself, #bMr. Moneybags#k has mentioned that only the power of the guardian spirit may awaken the necklace.
